description: Australian Cycling Participation Survey - Austroads is a collection of resources listed in the DITRDCSA Data Catalogue under the Road Safety Data (National Road Safety Hub) group, published by Austroads. The National Cycling Participation Survey (NCPS) is a standardised survey that has been repeated biennially since 2011. The NCPS provides data on cycling participation at a national level and allows for estimates of participation for each state and territory, and the capital cities and non-capital areas within each state and territory. Coverage is Australia, 2011 to 2019; spatial detail follows the source and is not stated in the entry. The catalogue lists the update frequency as less than annual, the status as non-current, and the entry was last changed on 2024-07-31. Files and pages listed: HTML (1 resources), reached from the source page and the catalogue entry, with the CKAN API giving the metadata. Access is free of charge and open; the licence is not stated in the catalogue entry (source page not read). Caveats: the record was written from the catalogue metadata only, so the source page was not opened, the file contents were not checked, and many entries are HTML landing pages or PDF reports, not data files. It can support capacity and investment planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-catalogue-australia.
